verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a code SDK for browser automation, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no first-party versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Validating actions with observe() before acting, session recording/replay, and caching that turns agent runs into deterministic scripts are adjacent features. Keeping automation code in the user's own git repo would be a user-side workaround, so none of these earn credit.
